items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 193:1
items.html: The six first Sefirot of Beriah, together with the point of the Chazeh [chest] that concludes them, are the aspect of the expansion of the city. And they are the secret of the seventy cubits and the remainder, which are still considered as the city itself, for likewise these seven Sefirot of Beriah are considered like the body of Atzilut, although they are already below the Parsa of Atzilut. And the reason, see above, answer 34. (Item 84, and in the Inner Light, Sub Header, "and they protrude").
